run_main_rerank: run the main function to send a rerank request to the vLLM server with a query and documents
send_post_rerank_request: send a POST request to the vLLM /rerank endpoint with a model, query, and list of documents
parse_rerank_response: parse the JSON response from the rerank API and print relevance scores for each document
build_rerank_payload: build a JSON payload with model name, query string, and list of documents for the rerank API
handle_rerank_error: handle a failed rerank API response by printing the status code and error text
